task_description: Write a method in Dafny to move all the numbers to the end of the given string.
specification_response:
Method Signature:
    method MoveNumbersToEnd(s: string) returns (result: string)
Postconditions_prompt:
    - The length of the output string is equal to the length of the input string
    - All numeric characters in the input string appear at the end of the output string
    - The relative order of non-numeric characters in the output matches their order in the input
    - The relative order of numeric characters in the output matches their order in the input
